body.name: Unrestricted randomized decision space \(\mathcal D\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal D=\{\delta\in L^{\infty}(\lambda^p):0\le\delta\le1\ \lambda^p\text{-almost everywhere}\}\), the positive order interval in the closed unit ball, equipped with \(\sigma(L^{\infty}(\lambda^p),L^1(\lambda^p))\). Its elements are \(\lambda^p\)-almost-everywhere equivalence classes. Whenever \(\delta(z)\) is written, an arbitrary Borel representative is used; because every \(N(h,\Sigma)\) is equivalent to \(\lambda^p\), \(q_{\delta}\), every regret, and every Bayes response are representative-invariant.
